findings.title: Test Optional Policy
findings.note: Applicants decide whether to submit SAT results for consideration; scores may be self-reported and are verified on enrolment.

findings.title: Test Optional Policy
findings.note: Applicants may choose ACT consideration independently of SAT. No test submission requirement under this general policy.

findings.title: Undergraduate Cost of Attendance
findings.note: Calculated baseline from the six published components: tuition 72,500 + activity fee 185 + housing 12,080 + food 9,520 + books 1,000 + personal expenses 2,700 USD. Travel varies and is additional; this is not a complete individual budget or a Fall 2027 price.

findings.title: Tuition, Fees & Other Costs
findings.note: Calculated baseline: tuition 75,330 + housing 10,980 + meals 9,340 + fees 710 + personal expenses 1,800 USD. Travel varies; health insurance is additional unless comparable coverage is accepted. Required course materials are included in the comprehensive fee. Not Fall 2027 pricing.

findings.title: Cost of Attendance 2026–2027
findings.note: Published standard three-term budget in USD. Additional first-year charges include 269 for records/class dues and 250 for orientation meals. Health insurance is 5,216 unless waived; computer and individual travel expenses also require planning. The page's travel allowance wording needs individual confirmation. Not a final Fall 2027 price.

findings.title: MIT Undergraduate Degree Charts
findings.note: Verified undergraduate degrees include Management (15-1), Business Analytics (15-2), Finance (15-3), Artificial Intelligence and Decision Making (6-4), and Mathematics (18). Graduate degrees are separately listed and are not used for these categories.
